Definition: a Giladite or descendant of Gilad
BiblicalUsage: Gileadite = "rocky region"; 1) an inhabitant of Gilead; 2) a branch of the tribe of Manasseh, descended of Gilead; 3) of Jephthah as the son of Gilead
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
